description: Use when the user asks what is new or what changed recently in AI startup revenue figures. Returns the change log, newest first: businesses added and figures added, revised, re-dated or removed, each with source_url; filters since (YYYY-MM-DD), slug, kind, limit (max 100). Example: {"since":"2026-10-14"} -> every change since Oct 14, 2026. Cost: free (100 calls/day without a key).
name: whats_new
title: What changed in the data
